description: Drupal's off-canvas library implementing side-loading dialogs with event handling, resizing, and padding adjustments.

methods.name: isOffCanvas
methods.description: Determines if a given element is an off-canvas dialog based on its ID.

methods.name: removeOffCanvasEvents
methods.description: Removes all off-canvas related event handlers from the element and document.

methods.name: beforeCreate
methods.description: Prepares dialog settings and cleans up previous event handlers before opening.

methods.name: beforeClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an off-canvas dialog is closed.

methods.name: afterCreate
methods.description: Sets up event handlers and attributes after the dialog has been created.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates dialog classes and attributes based on settings.

methods.name: handleDialogResize
methods.description: Adjusts dialog size dynamically on resize events.

methods.name: resetSize
methods.description: Resets and adjusts the size of the dialog based on current settings.

methods.name: bodyPadding
methods.description: Adjusts body padding when dialog is resized.

methods.name: getContainer
methods.description: Returns the dialog widget container element.

methods.name: getEdge
methods.description: Determines the screen edge ('left' or 'right') based on text direction.

methods.name: resetPadding
methods.description: Resets padding on main canvas wrapper and triggers displacement.
